verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin opens/creates a note for today's date automatically, and the Templates core plugin allows pre-filling notes with snippets, together enabling an automatic templated daily note as a capture landing spot; community evidence also confirms this is a common real-world workflow pattern (mixing daily notes with other structures). missing for 10: no independent corroboration specifically confirming daily-note-as-default-landing-page behavior or template auto-insertion combo in hands-on use.
